info.name: Vestax VCI-380 (hardware test)
info.author: JM Jacinto
info.description: Hardware test, not a DJ mapping. Left MODE buttons select the test: 1 all lights on, 2 LEDs (pads select an LED), 3 pad colours, 4 inputs: faders, knobs, encoders, strips and jogs drive the wheel LED, buttons light the pads. Results in the Mixxx log (--controller-debug).
